belief_update: I think I’m not as steady as people think I am, and that’s why I keep my distance — if they saw how much I crumble over small things, they’d see I don’t belong here. I expect people would treat me differently if they knew, like they’d start skipping over me or talk about me behind my back. I keep so much away because I don’t want to be seen as the kind of person who needs help, who can’t handle the pressure. I can’t hold that it doesn’t matter — it feels like it does, like it defines me. I let almost nothing show, not even to the people closest to me, because I believe the things I hide are proof of how little I’m worth.
